# Peter Holmes PhD Journal

> > PhD by Practice research journal documenting camera projection techniques and digital matte painting workflows for VFX environments.

This journal chronicles Peter Holmes' Leeds Beckett University PhD research exploring camera projection methodologies, matte painting workflows using NUKE and Photoshop, and digital environment creation techniques. The work builds on industry practices from artists like Garrett Fry and references foundational VFX texts including The Digital Matte Painting Handbook.

## Key Topics

- Camera Projection
- Matte Painting
- NUKE Compositing
- Photoshop Workflows
- Projection Mapping
- VFX Techniques
- Volumetric Lighting
- 3D Modeling & Rendering
- AOV Passes
- Texture Mapping
- Parallax Management
- PhD by Practice Research
- Digital Environments
- Garrett Fry Methodology

## Camera Projection Fundamentals

- [Camera Projection – Peter Holmes PhD Journal](https://pholmesphd.home.blog/2019/06/25/what-is-camera-projection): Historical overview of camera projection from 1700s spiritism to digital VFX
- [Projection Artefacts – Peter Holmes PhD Journal](https://pholmesphd.home.blog/2019/06/25/projection-artefacts): Identifying and solving smearing, doubling, and texture mapping issues
- [Patch Projection – Peter Holmes PhD Journal](https://pholmesphd.home.blog/2019/06/25/patch-projection): Extension of coverage projection for fixing gaps in hero projections
- [Layered Hierarchical Projection – Peter Holmes PhD Journal](https://pholmesphd.home.blog/2019/05/09/projection-tests-2): Powers of Ten technique using nested projections in NUKE for scale shots
- [Overscan & Camera Projection – Peter Holmes PhD Journal](https://pholmesphd.home.blog/2019/06/25/overscan): Solving perspective distortion in skydome coverage using overscan in NUKE

## Matte Painting Workflow & Pipeline

- [Workflow and Pipeline – Peter Holmes PhD Journal](https://pholmesphd.home.blog/2020/05/01/workflow-and-pipeline): 3D matte painting workflow using NUKE, based on Garrett Fry's approach
- [Propositional Statement – Peter Holmes PhD Journal](https://pholmesphd.home.blog/2020/11/29/propositional-statement): Photoshop and NUKE-only workflow exploration based on Garrett Fry method
- [Final Matte Painting – Peter Holmes PhD Journal](https://pholmesphd.home.blog/2020/05/01/final-matte-painting-2): NUKE compositing with light flicker effects and volumetric lighting setup
- [Preparatory Work on the Matte Painting – Peter Holmes PhD Journal](https://pholmesphd.home.blog/2020/11/29/project-1-stylised-meadow-scene): Layer organization and preparatory workflow for stylized meadow matte art
- [Overpainting – Peter Holmes PhD Journal](https://pholmesphd.home.blog/2022/05/03/overpainting): Photoshop layer structure standardization and AOV rendering workflow

## Lighting & 3D Integration

- [Light and Shadow – Peter Holmes PhD Journal](https://pholmesphd.home.blog/2020/05/01/light-and-shadow): Volumetric lighting and depth AOV pass rendering for atmospheric effects
- [CG Elements – Peter Holmes PhD Journal](https://pholmesphd.home.blog/2020/05/01/cg-elements): Integration of 3D church and industrial buildings for scene depth and scale
- [The Sky – Peter Holmes PhD Journal](https://pholmesphd.home.blog/2020/11/29/the-sky-2): Sphere projection geometry for sky rendering with parallax considerations

## PhD Research & Practice

- [Peter Holmes PhD Journal – Journal for PHd (by Practice) on Camera Projected Digital Environments](https://pholmesphd.home.blog): Leeds Beckett PhD journal on camera projection and matte painting VFX
- [Preamble – Peter Holmes PhD Journal](https://pholmesphd.home.blog/2022/12/17/preamble): Introduction to matte painting history from Lumière brothers to digital VFX
- [Project 1 Conclusion – Peter Holmes PhD Journal](https://pholmesphd.home.blog/2019/11/28/project-1-conclusion): Reflective practice analysis using Connelly & Clandinin's methodology
- [Propositional Document – Peter Holmes PhD Journal](https://pholmesphd.home.blog/2020/05/01/propositional-document): Victorian scene project proposal refining camera projection workflow

## Optional

- [Concept Art – Peter Holmes PhD Journal](https://pholmesphd.home.blog/2022/05/08/concept-art): Futuristic cityscape concept inspired by Blade Runner and sci-fi films
